basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. Passionate about open-source software and DIY projects. Enjoys gaming in the evenings, especially first-person shooters. Works as a freelance web developer. Often online during late-night hours due to freelance work schedule. In a relationship with a fellow tech lover.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science from a local university and has been self-teaching various programming languages since high school. Regularly participates in online courses to stay updated with the latest tech trends.
